item.title: Moonstone glows because light scatters within feldspar
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: The moving blue or silvery sheen called adularescence comes from microscopic feldspar structures. Cut orientation affects how strongly it appears.
EXIMUTC view: For blue moonstone, evaluate the face-up sheen across the actual cabochon, not just a static photograph.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/moonstone-description
